typography.displayDirection: condensed, strong; reuse project fonts where possible
typography.bodyDirection: readable sans serif; tabular numerals for money and statistics

controls.primary: amber surface, dark text, icon optional
controls.secondary: dark surface, ivory text, visible border
controls.status: text and symbol as well as color

layout.responsiveRule: content and available space determine reflow; breakpoints are starting points
layout.scene: decorative plate with independent semantic controls
layout.mobile: compact scene then decision panel; paginated collections
layout.dialog: existing R4 focus, stack and keyboard behavior

notes: Token values are proposals; verify contrast in final composited states.
Do not encode translated text or gameplay data in raster images.
This package adds no runtime dependency.
